description: A template of the library gains a `<video>` written in a namespace, `<x1:video>` — a letter and a digit, as Angular's lexer takes a prefix — and 1.2.1 keeps resting on the scan. `ngc` makes the same element of a prefixed `video` as of a bare one (measured with `foo:`): a video. Read with no prefix, the scan found none.
